# opusdns_organization_ip_restriction (Resource)

Manages an organization IP restriction for OpusDNS API access (`/v1/organizations/ip-restrictions`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opusdns_organization_ip_restriction" "example" {
  ip_network = "203.0.113.10/32"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_network` (String) IP address or CIDR network range allowed by this restriction.

### Read-Only

- `created_on` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the restriction was created.
- `id` (String) Mirror of `ip_restriction_id`.
- `ip_restriction_id` (String) Server-assigned IP restriction identifier.
- `last_used_on` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the restriction was last used, if reported by the API.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization that owns the IP restriction.
